lat: staqbelt d-dyaf f l-matar l-bare7
en: I welcomed the guests at the airport yesterday.

lat: ma staqbeltch l-mudir f l-biru
en: I didn't receive the director in the office.

lat: staqbelti l-3ayla dyalk b l-fer7a
en: You welcomed your family with joy.

lat: ma staqbeltich ch-charik f l-weqt
en: You didn't welcome the partner on time.

lat: staqbelti sa7btek f d-dar mzyan
en: You (f.) welcomed your friend at home well.

lat: ma staqbeltich n-nas b d-de7ka
en: You (f.) didn't welcome the people with a laugh.

lat: huwa staqbel l-wazir f l-m7etta
en: He welcomed the minister at the station.

lat: ma staqbelch l-ferqa j-jdida l-bare7
en: He didn't welcome the new team yesterday.

lat: staqblat l-walidin dyalha f l-matar
en: She welcomed her parents at the airport.

lat: ma staqblatch j-jiran dyalha f l-3id
en: She didn't welcome her neighbors at Eid.

lat: staqbelna l-muhandis f d-dar dyalna
en: We welcomed the engineer at our house.

lat: ma staqbelnach d-dyaf b atay skhun
en: We didn't welcome the guests with hot tea.

lat: staqbeltu l-weld s-sghir f l-mdrasa
en: You (pl.) welcomed the little boy at school.

lat: ma staqbeltuch l-musafer f l-otil
en: You (pl.) didn't receive the traveler at the hotel.

lat: staqblu l-3aris b z-zgharit f d-derb
en: They welcomed the groom with ululations in the alley.

lat: ma staqbluch l-khddam f l-weqt l-munasib
en: They didn't receive the worker at the right time.

lat: dima kanstaqbel n-nas b klam zwin
en: I always welcome people with kind words.

lat: ma kanstaqbelch d-dyaf f l-lil
en: I don't receive guests at night.

lat: wach nta katstaqbel d-dyaf kul sba7
ar: واش نتا كتستاقبل الضياف كل صباح
en: Do you welcome the guests every morning?

lat: nta ma katstaqbelch l-mu3ellimin mzyan
en: You don't welcome the teachers well.

lat: nti katstaqbli l-klyan b l-lbaqa
en: You (f.) welcome the clients politely.

lat: nti ma katstaqblich d-dyaf bla me3ad
ar: نتي ما كتستاقبليش الضياف بلا ميعاد
en: You (f.) don't receive guests without an appointment.

lat: l-babur kaystaqbel l-musaferin kul nhar
en: The ship welcomes passengers every day.

lat: huwa ma kaystaqbelch l-barani f d-dar
en: He does not welcome the stranger in the house.

lat: hiya katstaqbel l-3ayla b l-7lawa
en: She welcomes the family with sweets.

lat: hiya ma katstaqbelch ay wa7ed f l-maktab
ar: هي ما كتستاقبلش اي واحد فالمكتب
en: She doesn't receive just anyone in the office.

lat: 7na kanstaqblu n-nas j-jdad f l-7awma
en: We welcome the new people to the neighborhood.

lat: 7na ma kanstaqbluch d-dyaf f west l-khdma
ar: حنا ما كنستاقبلوش الضياف فوسط الخدمة
en: We don't receive guests in the middle of work.

lat: katstaqblu d-dyaf dyalkum b l-fer7
en: You welcome your guests with joy.

lat: ntuma ma katstaqbluch l-khddam bla qehwa
ar: نتوما ما كتستاقبلوش الخدام بلا قهوة
en: You (pl.) don't welcome the worker without coffee.

lat: l-muwaddafin kaystaqblu l-muwatinin b s-ser3a
en: The employees receive the citizens promptly.

lat: huma ma kaystaqbluch n-nas f l-weekend
en: They don't welcome people on the weekend.

lat: ghadi nstaqbel khuya f l-m7etta ghedda
en: I am going to welcome my brother at the station tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadich nstaqbel 7ed f s-sba7 bkri
ar: ما غاديش نستاقبل حد فالصباح بكري
en: I am not going to receive anyone early in the morning.

lat: nta ghadi tstaqbel l-muwaddaf j-jdid
en: You are going to welcome the new employee.

lat: ma ghadich tstaqbel d-dyaf bla biya
ar: ما غاديش تستاقبل الضياف بلا بيا
en: You are not going to welcome the guests without me.

lat: nti ghadi tstaqbli khti f d-dar
en: You (f.) are going to welcome my sister at the house.

lat: ma ghadich tstaqbli l-klyan l-yum
en: You (f.) are not going to receive the clients today.

lat: huwa ghadi ystaqbel l-mufattich f l-mdrasa
en: He is going to welcome the inspector at the school.

lat: huwa ma ghadich ystaqbel n-nas f d-dar
ar: هو ما غاديش يستاقبل الناس فالدار
en: He is not going to receive people at home.

lat: hiya ghadi tstaqbel l-bnt dyalha f l-bab
ar: هي غادي تستاقبل البنت ديالها فالباب
en: She is going to welcome her daughter at the door.

lat: hiya ma ghadich tstaqbel l-wafd l-berrani
ar: هي ما غاديش تستاقبل الوفد البراني
en: She is not going to receive the foreign delegation.

lat: 7na ghadi nstaqblu ch-chabab f n-nadi
en: We are going to welcome the youth at the club.

lat: ma ghadich nstaqblu n-nas bla tesjil
ar: ما غاديش نستاقبلو الناس بلا تسجيل
en: We are not going to welcome people without registration.

lat: ntuma ghadi tstaqblu t-tlamed j-jdad l-yum
ar: نتوما غادي تستاقبلو التلامد الجداد اليوم
en: You (pl.) are going to welcome the new students today.

lat: ntuma ma ghadich tstaqblu l-weld f l-lil
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تستاقبلو الولد فالليل
en: You (pl.) are not going to receive the boy at night.

lat: huma ghadi ystaqblu l-famila dyalhum f r-rbat
ar: هما غادي يستاقبلو الفاميلة ديالهم فالرباط
en: They are going to welcome their family in Rabat.

lat: huma ma ghadich ystaqblu d-dyaf f l-matar
ar: هما ما غاديش يستاقبلو الضياف فالمطار
en: They are not going to welcome the guests at the airport.
